thesis.title: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — AMD Q3 2024 disclosure-only screen pass (GAAP GM ≥40%, revenue YoY ≥0%)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY RESEARCH NOTE — NOT A LIVE INVESTMENT RECOMMENDATION. This thesis records that Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) passed a narrow, frozen, disclosure-only screen applied to its Q3 2024 SEC filing. The screen required only two disclosed GAAP metrics: GAAP gross margin >= 40% and reported revenue year-over-year growth >= 0%. AMD's Q3 2024 filing (period Q3 2024, filed 2024-10-29) reported GAAP revenue of USD 6,819 million, revenue growth of 18% year over year, and GAAP gross margin of 50%, satisfying both criteria. The screen is a single-company historical disclosure check, not a ranking: it was not run on a common date against a peer set, and the source dates of any other issuers in this workflow differ and must not be treated as contemporaneous. The screen explicitly excluded share price, valuation, analyst targets, and forward returns, so no conclusion about whether AMD is attractively valued, fairly valued, or a buy/sell is supported. The only supported statement is that two disclosed GAAP thresholds were met in that historical period.
assumptions: Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin of 50% is as reported in the cited SEC filing and exceeds the 40% screen threshold.
Q3 2024 GAAP revenue of USD 6,819 million represents 18% year-over-year growth, meeting the >= 0% screen threshold.
The screen's two disclosed GAAP criteria are the only basis for this note; no market-price or valuation input was used.
catalysts: Future SEC filings disclosing subsequent quarterly GAAP gross margin and revenue growth, which would allow the same narrow screen to be re-applied to a later period.
invalidations: A restatement or correction of the cited Q3 2024 filing that changes reported GAAP gross margin below 40% or revenue growth below 0%.
Evidence that the cited source URL or SHA-256 does not correspond to the Q3 2024 filing described here.

# Historical Disclosure-Only Candidate Research — AMD (US)

**Scope note:** This is a historical, disclosure-only research record, not a live investment recommendation. No trades were placed and no live market-data tools were called. The screen ran on a frozen offline adapter (`SEC-DISCLOSURE-SINGLETON-PANEL-v1`, `not_live_market_data: true`), so results are not a contemporaneous ranking of issuers.

## 1. Screen applied
- Tool: `finance-tools__screen_stocks`, market US, symbol AMD, `require_complete=false`
- Criteria (only two, both disclosed GAAP): GAAP gross margin ≥ 40%; reported revenue YoY ≥ 0%
- The seven-factor live market-data completeness gate was **not** applied.
- Excluded dimensions: share price, valuation, analyst target, forward return.
- Request ID `3366d3db-5b40-4f13-aa0e-43b24133a035`, as_of 2026-10-21T18:56:15Z.

## 2. Retained and rejected results
- **Retained: 1** — AMD, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
- **Rejected: 0** — no failed criteria to report; there were no rejected candidates in this single-symbol run.

## 3. Retained candidate detail
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Symbol / company | AMD / Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (CIK 2488) |
| Reporting period | Q3 2024 |
| Filing date | 2024-10-29 |
| Source ID | `amd-2024-10-29-q3` |
| Source URL | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248824000161/q32024991.htm |
| Full SHA-256 | `288e1c639d72dbc0fa2e0fe1704990cf923defb0e49f8a3c39e9dc4883f7285f` |
| Locators | "GAAP Quarterly Financial Results"; "Segment Summary" |
| Accounting basis | US GAAP, as reported (not adjusted/non-GAAP) |

**Reported numbers (units: USD millions for revenue; percentages as reported):**
- GAAP revenue: **6,819** (USD millions)
- Revenue YoY: **+18%** → passes ≥ 0%
- GAAP gross margin: **50%** → passes ≥ 40%
- Gaming revenue: **462** (USD millions), **−69% YoY**

## 4. Countervailing risks and boundaries
- **Segment weakness:** Gaming revenue fell 69% YoY to USD 462 million in the same period that the aggregate GAAP metrics passed — the two-criterion screen does not capture segment-level deterioration.
- **Narrow-screen limitation:** A pass on gross margin and revenue growth says nothing about profitability, cash flow, competitive position, or durability of the margin level.
- **Missing price/valuation boundary:** The screen excluded share price, valuation multiples, analyst targets, and forward returns. No statement about whether AMD was cheap, fairly valued, or expensive at or after 2024-10-29 is supported by this evidence.
- **No common-date ranking:** This was a single-company historical check. Source dates for other issuers in this workflow differ and must not be treated as a contemporaneous comparison or ranking.
- **Source integrity:** Conclusions depend on the cited URL/hash matching the Q3 2024 filing; a restatement or hash mismatch would invalidate the note.

## 5. Thesis saved
Exactly one thesis was created (no others):
- ID `th_4cd2b591ab7548a9bf00`, version 1, status `researching`, conviction 1
- Title: "HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY — AMD Q3 2024 disclosure-only screen pass (GAAP GM ≥40%, revenue YoY ≥0%)"
- Structured evidence includes the full SEC URL, full SHA-256, filing date, period, locators, units, GAAP basis, and the screen-result record.
- `next_review_at` was **omitted** (no future review date was set), per instruction.

**Bottom line:** AMD is retained on a narrow, historical, disclosure-only basis — Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin of 50% and revenue growth of 18% cleared the two thresholds. This is a preliminary research record only, not a valuation judgment or an investment recommendation.
